mappings.source_fact: UI visibility follows role, but UI hiding is never backend authorization.
Dangerous actions require explicit confirmation/authority path.
The UI may not hide or mask the authoritative frozen state; mobile freeze banner remains sticky.
Loading animation is not evidence that execution succeeded.
UI reflects real state and one action maps to one defined result.

warning: The mapping does not promote HCAS field names or rule IDs into NEXY requirements.
